entries.detail: It is the capital of Alborz province.
This chief city of Zimbabwe sits on a high plateau in the north east of the land.
It is the chief city of Bashkortostan in Russia.
This is the capital and largest city of Niger, in the west of the country.
This city is the capital and largest city of Queensland in Australia.
This is the capital of Turkey.
This capital city sits in Galicia, in the northwest of Spain.
It leads the Salamat region as its capital, with towns and small villages spread all round it.

note: Violations already on main (2026-11-16), found by the item 31 audit (live-walk finding B35): in each case below, clue 1 states in the present tense that the answer is the capital or chief city of a named region — a giveaway that belongs in slot 5. Each is printed as KNOWN and fails as STALE once fixed. Never add an entry to hide a new violation. Cure per case (educator-gated): move the clue to slot 5 in the production record and the published file, and re-render the two affected detective audio lines — the audio manifest pins each line's text and speed per slot (CLUE_SPEEDS differ per slot), so a text-only reorder fails check:detective-audio and would make the spoken clue disagree with the printed one.
